title: घोराही शून्य किलोमिटर कथामा शरीर राजनीति {Body Politics in The Story "Ghorahi Zero Kilometer"}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा लैङ्गिक अध्ययनअन्तर्गत नारीवादी समालोचनापद्धतिमा प्रचलित शरीर राजनीतिको अवधारणालाई आधार बनाएर गोविन्द गिरी प्रेरणाको ‘घोराही शून्य किलोमिटर’ कथामा भएको नारी शरीरमाथिको विभिन्न अवस्थाको प्रयोगको निरूपण गरिएको छ । लुसी इरिगेरी तथा मिसेल फुकोको शरीर राजनीतिसम्बन्धी अवधारणालाई मुख्य आधार बनाएर यस कथाको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन कार्यबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरिएको प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा पाठविश्लेषणका लागि निगमनात्मक विधि अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत शोध्य कथामा वादी समुदायका नारीहरू जीवन धान्नकै लागि यौन व्यवसाय गर्न बाध्य पारिएका र उनीहरूको बाध्यतालाई पितृसत्ताको प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने पुरूषहरूले विभिन्न अवस्थाबाट उपभोग गरिरहेको देखाइएको छ । यस अध्ययनले कथामा नारी शरीरको वस्तुकरण गरी पुरूषबाट भएको शोषण र विभेदको अवस्थाको प्रतिरोध गर्दै स्वअस्तित्वको खोजी गर्ने नारी चेतनाको विकास हुन पुगेको निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत गरेको छ ।
american_english: In this study, taking as a basis the concept of body politics prevalent in the feminist critical method under gender studies, the use of the female body in various conditions in Govinda Giri Prerana's story "Ghorahi Zero Kilometer" is analyzed. This story has been analyzed by taking as the main basis the concepts related to body politics of Luce Irigaray and Michel Foucault. In this study, for which materials were collected through library-based work, a deductive method was adopted for textual analysis. In the story under study, it is shown that women of the Badi community are compelled to engage in sex work in order to sustain their lives, and that men representing patriarchy exploit this compulsion of theirs in various conditions. This study presents the conclusion that in the story, by objectifying the female body and resisting the condition of exploitation and discrimination perpetrated by men, a female consciousness that seeks self-existence has developed.

informal_english: In this study, using the idea of body politics that's common in the feminist critical approach in gender studies as a starting point, it looks at how the female body is used in different situations in Govinda Giri Prerana's story "Ghorahi Zero Kilometer". This story's been analysed mainly using Luce Irigaray and Michel Foucault's ideas about body politics. For this study, the materials were gathered through library-based work, and a deductive method was used for the textual analysis. In the story being looked at, it shows that women from the Badi community are forced into sex work just to get by, and that men who represent patriarchy take advantage of that compulsion of theirs in all sorts of ways. This study wraps up by saying that in the story, by turning the female body into an object and pushing back against the exploitation and discrimination dished out by men, a female consciousness that's searching for its own sense of self has come through.
